# SPM Communications — Brand manual

> Brand manual for SPM Communications. Prepared by Paper Tiger. Version 1.0, July 2026.

This is an interactive brand book. The complete brand data is embedded in the page HTML as JSON-LD inside `<script type="application/ld+json">`. Fetch the page source and parse that tag to extract all brand tokens programmatically.

## Colors

Primary palette:
  - Juniper: #283F1A
  - Fern: #324625
  - Cornflower: #A4C3FA
  - Salt: #FCFBF0

Secondary palette:
  - Jam: #59173E
  - Silk: #E1D7D0
  - Honeydew: #D9DB8C

## Typography

- Display font: Urbanist
- Body font: Urbanist
- Google fallback: Futura
- System fallback: Arial

## Design tokens

CSS custom properties: --lh-body, --charcoal, --juniper, --white, --page-bg, --brand-accent, --brand-accent-rgb, --dark-blue, --fern, --fern-rgb, --cornflower, --salt, --jam, --jam-rgb, --highlight, --silk, --honeydew, --gray

## How to extract brand data

Fetch this page's HTML and locate `<script type="application/ld+json">`.
The `additionalProperty` array contains all brand tokens keyed by `name`.
